events.title: UK Economy Logs Better-Than-Expected Growth
events.description:
The UK economy expanded marginally in August defying expectations of a moderate contraction, as growth in industrial production offset the fall in construction.

events.title: Ericsson Q3 Profit Drops, Sales Rise; Simplifies Operating Structure; Stock Gains
events.description: Swedish telecom major LM Ericsson reported Thursday sharply lower profit in its third quarter, hurt mainly by the absence of prior year's significant divestment gain. Revenues, however, grew from last year, primarily with higher sales in Networks. Following the news, shares of Ericsson were gaining around 11 percent in Sweden, and around 12 percent in the pre-market activity on the Nasdaq.

events.title: Eurozone Industrial Output Drops For Third Month
events.description: The euro area industrial production declined for the third straight month in August, suggesting that harsh weather and rising energy prices weighed on industrial activity. Industrial output dropped 0.5 percent on a monthly basis in August, which was bigger than the 0.3 percent fall posted in July, data from Eurostat showed Thursday.

events.title: DAX Declines On Thursday As Tech Slide Deepens
events.description: The DAX benchmark that tracks the performance of the 40 largest companies listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange declined on Thursday amidst worries over artificial intelligence and fears of rising interest rates.

events.title: Indian Shares Rally Led By IT Stocks
events.description: Indian shares ended Thursday's session on a buoyant note as information technology stocks extended recent gains amid an ongoing tech sell-off in global markets on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises On RBNZ Conway's Hawkish Comments
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the late Asian session on Thursday, following the hawkish comments from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand or the RBNZ Chief Economist Paul Conway.

events.title: Gold Rebounds As Yields Dip On Dovish Fed Comments
events.description: Gold prices rebounded on Thursday, after having touched a one-week low in the previous session.

events.title: NZ Dollar Rises Against Majors
events.description: The New Zealand dollar strengthened against other major currencies in the late Asian session on Thursday.

events.title: Oil Prices Fall As US Weighs Relief For Sanctioned Shadow Fleet Vessels
events.description: Oil prices were sharply lower on Thursday due to profit taking following a recent rally as reports suggested the Trump administration is considering easing sanctions on so-called shadow fleet vessels in order to reduce record-high global freight rates.

events.title: European Shares Mixed As Oil Prices, Yields Ease
events.description: European stocks were mixed on Thursday as oil prices fell and Eurozone government bond yields slipped, tracking an overnight decline in U.S. Treasury yields.

events.title: Asian Shares Retreat On Tech Rout
events.description: Asian stocks retreated on Thursday, with AI and semiconductor stocks coming under heavy selling pressure on concerns about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence trade.

events.title: Australian Dollar Falls On Weak Jobs Data
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday, after the release of Australia's weak jobs data in September.

events.title: Australian Dollar Falls Against Majors
events.description: The Australian dollar weakened against other major currencies in the Asian session on Thursday.
